roles_en: Prime minister of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Թիֆլիս՝ 1874-ին։ Թիֆլիսի քաղաքագլուխ (1909-1917) եւ Հայաստանի Հանրապետութեան վարչապետ (1919-1920), մահացած է Փարիզ՝ 1945-ին։
bio_en: Alexander Khatisian was born in Tiflis in 1874 into the prominent Khatisian family. He sympathised with the ARF early but, on the advice of Rostom and Hamo Ohanjanian, stayed out of the party until 1917 so as to serve as a non-partisan national figure; he was elected to the Tiflis city council in 1902, was deputy mayor in 1906 and mayor of Tiflis from 1909 to 1917, and in 1914-17 chaired the union of fourteen Caucasian cities. After independence he signed the peace treaty with Turkey with Kajaznuni and served as prime minister of Armenia from February 1919 to May 1920; in 1920 it fell to him to sign the Treaty of Alexandropol. He died in Paris on 10 March 1945.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
